items.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: one standalone production profile avatar sprite for Memory Match Adventure, item memory-avatar-scholar-squirrel, Vietnamese name Sóc Thư Sinh. Generate ONE image, no sheet, no comparison.
Primary request: a warm brown young squirrel hugging a small book, lit by a golden library lamp, face clearly readable in a circular portrait. Enchanting library atmosphere inside the circle.
Style: rich polished storybook fantasy game art, softly painted dimensional fur, large expressive amber eyes, delicate gold light, cream book pages, midnight blue shadows. Friendly and finely rendered, consistent with luxury blue-and-gold animal portrait collectible art. No letters or symbols on the book.
Composition: square canvas. A perfectly circular portrait centered at 50%/50%, diameter approximately 75% of canvas, all ears and tail inside this circular silhouette. Face dominates upper center, little book visible below. Circle contains the library scene, outside circle truly transparent. No decorative frame or ring. Generous transparent outer padding; complete silhouette no clipping.
Output constraints: RGBA with genuine transparent outside, no checkerboard painted in image, no text, numbers, logos, watermark, UI or badges. This is an avatar layer only; a separate frame will later be overlaid.

Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: one standalone equipable circular profile FRAME sprite, Memory Match Adventure item memory-frame-gilded-pages, Trang Sách Vàng. Generate ONE isolated frame only.
Primary request: ornate golden book-pages frame: a continuous circular golden rim built from layered curled ivory book leaves with gilded paper corners; an open blank miniature book forms a crest at the bottom, pages curling around the sides. No lettering.
Style: rich polished storybook fantasy collectible game art, dimensional warm gold highlights and cream parchment, dark cobalt small accent bindings, finely painted surfaces. Elegant readable silhouette at small leaderboard size.
Composition: frontal perfectly circular ring, center at 50%/50% of square. Outer diameter about 88% canvas, opening diameter about 65% canvas. Keep a broad clean circular aperture with generous empty center. Ornaments outside aperture; book crest at bottom may overlap rim only. Complete frame within canvas with transparent padding on all four sides.
Critical constraints: BOTH outside the ring and entire circular center genuinely transparent alpha, hollow ring only. NO portrait, animal, face, filling scene, background disk, interior parchment, UI, text, numbers, logos, watermark or painted checkerboard. This frame must overlay arbitrary separate avatars.
items.editPrompt: Edit only the framing/padding of this isolated golden book-pages avatar FRAME. Preserve the same design, gold-and-ivory pages, dark blue binding, bottom open book, circular hollow opening, frontal view, and genuinely transparent alpha both outside and inside the ring. Make the entire ring and ALL ornament tips fully visible, scaled smaller to leave a generous 8% transparent margin on EVERY side. Reconstruct any cropped top/side ornament tip so none touches the canvas. Keep centered on a square. This is a separate empty frame: no portrait, no filling disk or background, no scene. No text, letters, numbers, watermark.
items.editReason: Original ornament touched native source edges; redraw with transparent margins. The padded revision measured an 838x752 aperture and failed the unchanged circularity limit; redraw aperture geometry.
items.geometryEditPrompt: Use case: precise-object-edit. Fix the inner aperture geometry of this standalone avatar frame. Preserve its ornate gilded book pages, ivory parchment, dark blue binding, and open-book bottom crest, all on transparent background. Change ONLY geometry: make the empty aperture a TRUE CIRCLE exactly centered in the canvas, equal width and height. All inner edges of the ring follow this continuous circle. Move the bottom open book DOWN and make it slightly smaller so it does NOT intrude into or flatten the circular opening. Move the top inward-pointing ornament OUTWARD so it does not intrude. Keep aperture diameter around 62% of square canvas, outer ornaments around 90%, leave transparent margin on every side. Both center and outside must be genuinely transparent alpha. Ring fully closed, no gaps or portrait, no scene, no text, no watermark.

items.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: one standalone production profile badge sprite, Memory Match Adventure item memory-badge-wisdom-seal, Dấu Ấn Tri Thức.
Primary request: a round engraved bronze seal medallion showing one small antique key and one five-point star in raised gold relief, mounted on a folded deep blue velvet ribbon. No ranking number. One icon only.
Style: rich polished storybook fantasy game collectible art, dimensional antique bronze and gold, cream highlights, dark blue velvet folds. Delicate engraving limited to borders, crisp clear central key and star readable at 28 pixels. Warm light upper left.
Composition: centered square canvas, all ornament and ribbon tips completely inside canvas with at least 10% clear padding on each edge, outer silhouette nearly square. Frontal medallion, key diagonally across center with star above it. No animal or portrait, no surrounding wreath.
Constraints: genuine transparent background alpha outside the isolated badge, no scene, shadows on transparent background only attached to badge, no UI, text, letters, numbers, logos, watermark or painted checkerboard.
